mentl/699b426:
The Rust VM's to_string(ADT) renders 'FnStmt(...)' / 'Declared(...)' strings
the checker, pipeline, and lowerer then inspect via starts_with. memory.lux's
to_string (used in WASM) just returns the raw pointer for any val >= 1024 —
it has no idea how to render variants. So prescan_fns_at, needs_instantiation,
extract_builtin_names_at, is_builtin_reason, validate_ownership_fns_at,
walk_for_matches, validate_refinements_loop, prescan_fn_names all silently
treated every statement as non-FnStmt inside the WASM bootstrap.

The answer lives in the structure itself — variant tags are directly
observable via match. Seven call sites now pattern-match instead of
stringifying. Same semantics in the Rust VM, actually correct semantics
in WASM.

Unblocks wasm_check through the bootstrap: env length 21 instead of
a flood of 'unknown variable parse_block' false positives.

The Daisy Seed's 64 MB external SDRAM was completely unused. The heap
was crammed into 256 KB of D2 SRAM, which couldn't fit DelayKernel's
768 KB allocation (2s × 48kHz × 2ch × 4B). Commercial pedals use
static buffer pools in SDRAM for exactly this reason.

New sdram.rs module absorbs daisy-embassy's FMC initialization:
- MPU Region 0 at 0xC0000000 (write-back cacheable, 64 MB)

  power-up sequence (clock enable → 200µs → precharge → auto-refresh)
- Fixed daisy-embassy's MPU base address bug (0xD0000000 → 0xC0000000)

Also fixes embassy timer config (time-driver-tim5, tick-hz-32_768) and
adds enable_d2_sram() for DMA buffer access. All 19 kernels now
benchmark successfully on hardware — delay at 14.24% budget.

Memory architecture: DTCM (stack, 0-wait) → D2 SRAM (DMA only) →
SDRAM (heap — delay lines, reverb, everything else).

sonido/6980734:
sqrt(1-fb) is mathematically insufficient for single comb filters: at
resonance, output = c/(1-fb) > 1 for all fb > 0. Change to (1-fb) which
gives exact cancellation: (1-fb)/(1-fb) = 1.0 at any feedback setting.

Reverb keeps sqrt(1-fb) inline — its 8 parallel combs with 1/8 averaging
provide ~18 dB additional headroom, making exact compensation too aggressive
(would attenuate hall wet signal to -34 dB).

Measured results (440 Hz sine, 0 dBFS, default params):
  delay:   -0.8 → -2.0 dBFS
  flanger: -0.5 → -2.1 dBFS
  phaser:  -1.1 → -2.6 dBFS
  reverb:  -1.6 → -1.6 dBFS (unchanged)
  All 15/15 effects pass -1 dBFS ceiling.

clob/699a43b:
Path B Phase 3: the full-model backward pass, the piece that unblocks
core training. Composes the checked leaf backwards (grad.rs) and the
checked one-step SSM backward (ssm.rs) into a truncated-BPTT backward
over a T-token window through the dense stack, gated end to end by a
finite-difference check on a tiny model.

The composition is what needed proving. Each dense block is
  h_mid = x     + SSM(RMSNorm1(x))
  x_out = h_mid + GLU(MLGRU(RMSNorm2(h_mid)))
so the residual stream splits the gradient at every sublayer boundary,
and TWO recurrences -- the SSM state and the MLGRU state -- couple the
timesteps. backward_window runs the outer loop in reverse over tokens
carrying a per-layer future-state gradient for each recurrence, and the
inner loop in reverse over layers with the residual splits, then scatters
the embedding gradient. DenseModel::forward_window records the tape.

Untied readout: embed and readout are separate [vocab x d_model] tables
with independent gradients (grad.rs already had the slice-level
unembed_forward/backward for exactly this). The deployed inference model
still ties them; untying here is what lets a readout-only path move and
is the config Path B calls for. Wiring the untied readout into the
persisted model is Phase 4.

Gate: dense_model_end_to_end_gradient_matches_finite_difference (T=3)
and single_token_window_also_checks (T=1). f32 central differences over
a T-step through-time composition bottom out near 1.3% on the smaller
on-path gradients (analytic vs numerical still agree there, e.g.
-6.70e-3 vs -6.78e-3); a real composition bug lands at O(1), so the
margin catches it with ~10x headroom. The differentiated object is the
f32 latent surrogate, in the STE-mask-open regime the leaf checks use;
the STE->ternary bridge stays separate per the trust chain.
every_trainable_family_has_nonzero_gradient guards against a vacuous
pass by asserting each family -- embed, per-layer SSM/MLGRU/GLU/norm
params, a_log/d_param/dt_bias, final norm, readou
